My calendar has a recurring block called thinking and I have moved it eleven times this month.

Every time, the thing that displaced it was a status update about work I had not had time to think about.

So the block now has a fake attendee: a vendor named Focus Ltd. Nobody reschedules a vendor.

Three weeks in, the vendor has the best attendance record on the team.
